The '''attack on the Raithal Academy''' occurred shortly prior to [[battle of Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|We're under attack. A Rebel strike force has landed just outside the Academy.|An Imperial [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]]|<ref name="Squadrons Over Corellia" />}}
With direct orders from the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] himself, [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Forces]] have established a head hunter squadron on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Their mission was to seek out and destroy a [[Talus base|secret Rebel base]] on the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. At the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], a week-long briefing was being held about an upcoming operation in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The Alliance had launched a raid on the academy, aimed to disrupt the imperial planning.

A group led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Coret Bhan]] performed a hit-and-run attack on the Raithal Academy. A Rebel strike force has landed just outside the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] and - without trying to capture or destroy it - tried to disrupt Imperial planning and benefit from the propaganda reports about the Rebel attacking the most prestige Imperial Academy. When the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] of Academy put up reasonable defense, Rebel forces fell back in good order towards their landing craft, leaving behind some explosives which they planned to use to blow the starport on their way out.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle is featured in the first scenario of Dark Side campaign from ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'', the second expansion of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.
